svg.text: Q/K/V copy order: separate calls, tensor-major group, peer-major group
After each tensor, every rank waits at a barrier for the slowest rank; all links sit idle meanwhile.
Grouped, tensor-major (all Q, then K, then V)
A lagging rank shares a source link with a neighbor for each K/V copy; other links go idle.
Grouped, peer-major (per peer: Q, K, V)
Each source is read for a whole Q+K+V block, so the lag overlaps only block edges.
Illustrative bandwidth-sharing model, P = 4, self copies omitted; rank 1 starts slightly late after each barrier. Dashed line = finish.
